# AIS-EVAL-08

**Is permission trimming tested as people with different access, with zero tolerance for content a user may not read?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | EVAL: Evaluation as evidence |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.grounding.access_control`, `elements.ai.evals.zero_tolerance`, `elements.ai.evals.gating` |

## Why it matters

A leak of restricted content is not a quality trade-off to balance against recall. It is a security failure, so it gets its own eval, run as test users whose access differs, and a single leak fails it.

## Rule

Every ai facet whose grounding access_control is document-level or caller-permission-trimmed has an eval with zero_tolerance true and gating true.
